head: xbr (< Arab. xbr (II) cf. Wehr 317: benachrichtigen, in Kenntnis setzen;)

examples.turoyo: hat ʕal d-aṯət w-mxabállux-li w-lə=tlelux meni, qum izúx mobel-e l-ruḥux, w-məṯnáḥ m-u=taʕb-ano
examples.translation: Since you have come, have reported [this] to me and have not hidden yourself from me, go and take [the treasure] and rest from this trouble
examples.raw: hat ʕal d-aṯət w-mxabállux-li w-lə=tlelux meni, qum izúx mobel-e l-ruḥux, w-məṯnáḥ m-u=taʕb-ano ʻSince you have come, have reported [this] to me and have not hidden yourself from me, go and take [the treasure] and rest from this troubleʼ; 244; 47/14;

examples.turoyo: izolux mxabár ḥoli, amár k-aṯi Naro!
examples.translation: geh und benachrichtige meinen Onkel, sage: Naro ist gekommen
examples.raw: izolux mxabár ḥoli, amár k-aṯi Naro! ʻgeh und benachrichtige meinen Onkel, sage: Naro ist gekommenʼ; 248; 69/569;
